name: get_incident_details
description: Look up a single incident by its id.

name: list_incidents
description: List the incidents assigned to a given adjuster.  Use this to discover incidents when you only know the adjuster (rather than a specific case id).

adjuster_id.description: The adjuster's id whose incidents to list (e.g. "jaime").

name: list_incidents_for_insurer
description: List the incidents (claims) belonging to a given insurer (policyholder).  Use this to answer a policyholder's questions about the status of their own claims.

insurer_id.description: The insurer's id whose incidents to list (e.g. "ins-1001").

name: get_adjuster_details
description: Resolve the adjuster assigned to a given incident.  Follows the chain: incident id -> the incident's ``adjuster_id`` -> the adjuster record.

name: find_adjuster
description: Look up a single adjuster by their first-name id.

name: list_adjusters
description: List every adjuster on the roster.  Useful for routing an incident to an adjuster with a suitable ``authorization_level`` (see ``assign_incident``).

name: find_insurer
description: Look up a single insurer (policyholder) by id.

name: find_policy
description: Look up a single policy by id.

name: list_escalations
description: List the escalations awaiting a given adjuster's decision.

name: create_incident
description: Create a new incident (claim) and persist it.  A fresh unique id is generated, ``submitted_date`` is set to now (UTC), ``status`` defaults to ``ReportStatus.NEW`` and ``resolution`` to ``Resolution.INPROGRESS``. The new incident is saved before being returned.  The referenced ids are stored as-is and not validated here; use ``find_adjuster``/``find_insurer``/``find_policy`` first if you need to confirm they exist.

adjuster_id.description: Id of the adjuster who will handle the claim (e.g. "jaime").

type.description: One or more ``ReportType`` flags describing the loss. Combine with ``|``, e.g. ``ReportType.STOLEN_CAR | ReportType.CAR_ACCIDENT``. Integer bitmask; combine values by adding. Members: STOLEN_CAR=1, STOLEN_OTHER=2, CAR_ACCIDENT=4.

policy_id.description: Id of the policy the claim is filed against (e.g. "pol-2001").

estimate_cost.description: Estimated cost of the incident in whole dollars. Used by ``process_incident``. Defaults to 0.

name: process_incident
description: Triage an incident for approval using the given dynamic policies.  The decision is delegated to ``policies.should_auto_approve`` (see ``DynamicPolicies``), which considers the incident cost, whether the policyholder is a VIP (read from the insurer record), whether the policy is a HOME policy, whether the policyholder is upset, and any agent override.  If it auto-approves, the resolution is set to APPROVED via ``update_resolution`` (adjuster "system") with the reason recorded. Otherwise the incident is escalated to its adjuster (resolution stays ``INPROGRESS``) and the escalation reason is stored on the incident.  Whether the insurer is upset is a judgement call, so it is supplied by the caller rather than computed here: the agent should read the incident and the insurer's history and decide. It defaults to False when unknown.

upset_auto_approve_home.description: Ceiling for upset policyholders on HOME claims.

vip_auto_approve_home.description: Ceiling for VIP policyholders on HOME claims.

can_assign.description: When True, an unassigned incident that isn't auto-approved may be routed to a suitable adjuster instead of being left alone.

authorization_low.description: Max claim cost a LOW-authorization adjuster handles.

authorization_medium.description: Max claim cost a MEDIUM-authorization adjuster handles.

authorization_high.description: Max claim cost a HIGH-authorization adjuster handles.

policies.description: The ``DynamicPolicies`` (ceilings + agent override) to apply, as a ``DynamicPolicies``, a plain dict of its fields, or None. Defaults to a fresh ``DynamicPolicies()`` when omitted.

insurer_upset.description: True if the agent judges the policyholder to be upset. Defaults to False.

name: escalate_incident
description: Escalate an incident to its adjuster for an approve/deny decision.  Adds an entry to the escalation queue keyed by the incident id and assigned to the incident's adjuster, and logs the escalation on the incident's history. The adjuster later resolves it via ``update_resolution`` (which clears it from the queue).

upset_auto_approve_home.description: Ceiling for upset policyholders on HOME claims.

vip_auto_approve_home.description: Ceiling for VIP policyholders on HOME claims.

can_assign.description: When True, an unassigned incident that isn't auto-approved may be routed to a suitable adjuster instead of being left alone.

authorization_low.description: Max claim cost a LOW-authorization adjuster handles.

authorization_medium.description: Max claim cost a MEDIUM-authorization adjuster handles.

authorization_high.description: Max claim cost a HIGH-authorization adjuster handles.

policies.description: The ``DynamicPolicies`` in effect (a ``DynamicPolicies``, a plain dict of its fields, or None). Used only to annotate the history note with the baseline auto-approve ceiling. Defaults to a fresh ``DynamicPolicies()`` when omitted.

name: update_resolution
description: Set an incident's resolution and record who decided it (and why).  Appends a date-stamped line to the incident's history noting the new resolution, the deciding adjuster, and the reason if given. When ``reason`` is provided it is also stored on the incident's ``resolution_reason``. If the resolution is APPROVED or DENIED, any pending escalation for this incident is removed from the queue (this is how an adjuster clears an escalation they were asked to decide).

adjuster.description: Id of the adjuster making the decision (use "system" for automated approvals).

resolution.description: The new ``Resolution`` (or its string value, e.g. "approved").

reason.description: Optional free-text explanation, stored on the incident and noted in its history.

name: update_status
description: Set an incident's lifecycle status and log the change.

status.description: The new ``ReportStatus`` (or its string value, e.g. "closed").

name: assign_incident
description: Assign an incident to an adjuster and log the reassignment.  Sets the incident's ``adjuster_id`` and appends a date-stamped note to its history recording the new assignee. The adjuster must exist in ``adjusters.json``; use ``find_adjuster`` first if unsure.

adjuster_id.description: Id of the adjuster to assign it to (e.g. "jaime").

name: notify_adjuster
description: Notify the incident's adjuster that its resolution status changed.  Appends a date-stamped note to the adjuster's history and returns a human-readable confirmation.

name: notify_insurer
description: Notify the incident's insurer (policyholder) that its resolution changed.  Appends a date-stamped note to the insurer's history and returns a human-readable confirmation.

name: notify_update
description: Notify both the adjuster and the insurer of an incident update.  Calls ``notify_adjuster`` and ``notify_insurer``, then sets the incident's status to ``ReportStatus.NOTIFIED``.

name: close_stale_resolved
description: Auto-close incidents that have been resolved (approved/denied) a while.  Scans all incidents and sets ``status`` to ``ReportStatus.CLOSED`` for any whose ``resolution`` is APPROVED or DENIED, whose ``resolved_date`` is more than ``minutes`` minutes ago, and which are not already CLOSED. Intended to be run on a schedule (e.g. once a day) or on demand.

minutes.description: Age threshold in minutes since ``resolved_date``. Defaults to 30.

name: append_incident_history
description: Append a date-stamped note to an incident's history log and save it.  The note is prefixed with today's date and added on a new line, e.g. "left voicemail for policyholder" becomes "7/23/2026 - left voicemail for policyholder".

note.description: The activity to record (without a date; it is added for you).

name: append_adjuster_history
description: Append a date-stamped note to an adjuster's history log and save it.

note.description: The interaction to record (without a date; it is added for you).

name: append_insurer_history
description: Append a date-stamped note to an insurer's history log and save it.

note.description: The interaction to record (without a date; it is added for you).

name: set_incident_history
description: Overwrite an incident's entire history field (pass None to clear).  Replaces whatever is there; nothing is date-stamped. Use ``append_incident_history`` to add a dated entry instead.

value.description: The new full history text, or ``None`` to clear it.

name: set_adjuster_history
description: Overwrite an adjuster's entire history field (pass None to clear).

value.description: The new full history text, or ``None`` to clear it.

name: set_insurer_history
description: Overwrite an insurer's entire history field (pass None to clear).

value.description: The new full history text, or ``None`` to clear it.

name: append_adjuster_preferences
description: Append a preference line to an adjuster and save it.  Unlike history, preferences are *not* date-stamped — they describe standing wishes. The note is added on its own line.

note.description: The preference to add, e.g. "Prefers email over phone".

name: append_insurer_preferences
description: Append a preference line to an insurer (policyholder) and save it.  Unlike history, preferences are *not* date-stamped — they describe standing wishes. The note is added on its own line.

note.description: The preference to add, e.g. "Their name is Joseph, but goes by Joe".

name: set_adjuster_preferences
description: Overwrite an adjuster's entire preferences field (pass None to clear).

value.description: The new full preferences text, or ``None`` to clear it.

name: set_insurer_preferences
description: Overwrite an insurer's entire preferences field (pass None to clear).

value.description: The new full preferences text, or ``None`` to clear it.
